problem:
Title: Binomial Theorem/Multiindex

Let $\alpha$ be a [[Definition:Multiindex|multiindex]], [[Definition:Indexing Set|indexed]] by $\set {1, \ldots, n}$ such that $\alpha_j \ge 0$ for $j = 1, \ldots, n$.

Let $x = \tuple {x_1, \ldots, x_n}$ and $y = \tuple {y_1, \ldots, y_n}$ be [[Definition:Ordered Tuple|ordered tuples]] of [[Definition:Real Number|real numbers]].

Then:
:$\ds \paren {x + y}^\alpha = \sum_{0 \mathop \le \beta \mathop \le \alpha} \dbinom \alpha \beta x^\beta y^{\alpha - \beta}$

where $\dbinom n k$ is a [[Definition:Binomial Coefficient/Multiindices|binomial coefficient]].
